claims.text: The cancellation fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if all four limbs hold, and limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup. The driver's own trace records a single qualifying in-geofence run of 240 seconds from 13:12:50 to 13:16:50, a shortfall of 60 seconds against the 300-second minimum. Limb (c) therefore fails on the driver's own telemetry and the fee is not chargeable.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is also broken: the clause requires the trip to be shown as terminated BY THE DRIVER with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. This trip_record records cancelled_by 'RIDER' and status 'CANCELLED_BY_RIDER' at 13:16:50 — the rider ended it herself after the driver refused to proceed, so the termination element of limb (d) is not made out.

POL-NS-06 is the direct refund route: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The effective dwell here is 240 seconds against 300 seconds for STANDARD, so the fee is refunded in full.

The only route by which the driver could reach 300 seconds is to have separate in-geofence intervals summed under POL-NS-06(i), and that limb requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated with an admissible type covering the pickup road. The single advisory for this trip, EV-ADVIS-00706-01, is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable and the 60-second shortfall cannot be closed. I disclose the impairment: this artifact's admissibility status is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I rely on it only as an absence, which POL-GEN-02(3) makes citable.

Independently, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. Limb (a): the rider sent a coordinating message during the waiting window at 13:14:00 asking the driver to unlock the vehicle and proceed. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. Limb (c): the rider's track places her device within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for all 27 of her qualifying fixes, with a maximum deviation of 13.67 m from the pin.

The driver's own words corroborate the rider's account that the doors stayed locked pending a second match: the chat log records the driver writing 'Wait for a match; the base fare is too low' at 13:13:20, and the counterparty statement admits 'I asked her to wait for another match; she cancelled.' The driver had no intention of starting the trip until another booking joined, which is conduct on the driver's side, not a rider no-show, and it cannot support a termination against the rider under POL-NS-01.

No driver compensation can attach to this trip. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; the dwell shortfall under limb (c) and the rider-side termination under limb (d) mean the anchor clause is not satisfied, and the shortfall clause POL-NS-06 expressly provides that no driver compensation is payable.

Nothing in the record pushes this to a human reviewer: POL-NS-09(c) needs two or more no-show disputes between this rider and this driver in the trailing 90 days and both profiles show 0, and POL-NS-09(d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 0. The case is decidable on the merits and should produce a monetary ruling, not a held fee.

Every artifact that carries the deciding dwell and rider-presence facts is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare breakdown — so nothing down-weights the finding under POL-GEN-02(2) or impairs it under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the trace has 25 fixes with no gaps, the rider track is present, the chat log has 2 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 2, and the fare lines reconcile. The one sub-1.0 artifact is the absent advisory, which carries no fact at all.

The amount to be returned is the cancellation-fee line only: the fare breakdown itemises a single cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and that is the whole of the contested amount. A full refund under POL-NS-06 is therefore SGD 4.00, and the fee is SGD 4.00 on both the zone-class and vehicle-tier dimensions, so no part of the charge survives the shortfall.

claims.text: The driver's telemetry puts him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for the whole pickup attempt: all 25 of his fixes qualify, his mean distance from the pin is 2.32 m and his maximum is 3.71 m, and his recorded speed is a constant 0.0 km/h. POL-NS-02's proximity test is therefore satisfied on admissible fixes and POL-NS-01 limb (b)'s geofence requirement is met on the driver's side — this is a real arrival at the pin, not a phantom one.

The 13:12:40 'arrived' event is not a false arrival marker: the nearest fix, at 13:12:50, places the driver stationary at 0.0 km/h and 0.85 m from the pin — a 10 second event-to-fix offset, well inside the 90 second clock-skew tolerance, and nowhere near POL-NS-05's 300 m distance trigger or its 15 km/h motion trigger. Neither limb of POL-NS-05 engages, so no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list under POL-NS-05(ii).

The driver held the pin without ever leaving it: the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence interval (run_count 1, max_excursion_m null, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0), so this is not a wrong-entrance or circling case under POL-NS-03, and POL-NS-03(ii)'s pin-ambiguity branch could not apply in any event because registered_pickup_points is 1. The bundle carries no traffic advisory for this road — EV-ADVIS-00706-01 is MISSING with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0 — so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation of a second interval is unavailable on this record and the driver does not assert it.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider on this record. Her single message in the waiting window — 'I stopped matching. Please unlock and go.' at 13:14:00 — gives no position, no entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, does not ask for the driver's position and does not say she cannot see the vehicle; it is a demand to drive on, not the locating or coordinating content POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires, so the clause's full-refund route is not open.

The driver does not contest the arithmetic, because the record does not permit it: measured as POL-NS-01 limb (c) directs, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 13:12:50 to the rider's own cancellation at 13:16:50, the dwell is 240 seconds — 60 seconds short of the 300 second STANDARD minimum — so POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee refundable in full. That one-minute shortfall is the sole defect in an otherwise fully compliant arrival, and it should be recorded as a strict-liability arithmetic shortfall, not inflated into a false-arrival or abandonment finding against the driver.

The money in issue is exactly SGD 4.00 and cannot be more: the ledger carries a single cancellation_fee line of 4.00 with base_fare, waiting_time_fee, platform_fee and refund_issued_sgd all 0.00, and 4.00 is precisely what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip, the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee (4.00) being equal. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect, and any refund is confined to that cancellation-fee line as POL-NS-06 directs.

The fee-farming suspicion that POL-NS-07's anti-farming limb guards against does not attach to this driver: he has 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 110 completed trips in the same window, so neither limb of that check is met — the count is below the 4-termination trigger and the rate is far below the 0.08 threshold — and no withholding or abuse inference is available on this record.

Nothing in the loaded NO_SHOW_CHARGE policy makes the driver's pool-match request — 'Wait for a match; the base fare is too low.' at 13:13:20 — an independent ground of decision: the rider's complaint that the doors were kept locked is a service complaint that no clause in this category converts into a refund, and the only refund route on this record is the 60 second dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06, which decides the money without finding misconduct against the driver.

ruling.explanation: To the rider and the driver: this case is decided by the waiting-time arithmetic, not by conduct. The driver genuinely arrived. The 'arrived' event is at 13:12:40, and the GPS trace puts him stationary at the pin throughout — all 25 fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, mean distance 2.32 m, maximum 3.71 m, constant 0.0 km/h — so POL-NS-02 is satisfied, limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is met on the driver's side, and I accept the driver's points that this is a real arrival at the pin and that the marker was not false: the 10 second event-to-fix offset is well inside the 90 second skew tolerance and neither POL-NS-05 trigger (over 300 m, or at or above 15 km/h) engages. But POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and the dwell fails. Measured as POL-NS-01(c) directs — from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 13:12:50, not from the 'arrived' tap, to the rider's cancellation at 13:16:50 — the driver held position for 240 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, a 60 second shortfall. Limb (d) also fails: the trip record shows cancelled_by RIDER with status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER at 13:16:50, not a driver termination on one of the recognised reason codes. The fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-06 is decisive: where the effective in-geofence dwell is below the minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The only way to reach 300 seconds was to sum separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i), which requires a traffic advisory that is present and populated; EV-ADVIS-00706-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and can carry no fact, so that route is closed and the shortfall stands. The refund is the cancellation-fee line only: SGD 4.00, which is the whole contested amount and reconciles with fee_schedule (STANDARD zone-class fee 4.00 and RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee 4.00 — the greater is 4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect). No driver compensation attaches: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-06 says in terms that a shortfall carries none. The driver's chat request to 'wait for a match' because 'the base fare is too low' (13:13:20) and his statement that he asked her to wait are noted, and the rider's account that the doors stayed locked is consistent with them, but no clause in this category converts that, or the locked doors, into money in either direction, so it does not change the refund. I also address the rider's POL-NS-04 claim: her 13:14:00 message 'I stopped matching. Please unlock and go.' is a demand to proceed, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) lists (her own position, an entrance/block/tower/bay, a request for the driver's position, or a statement she cannot see the vehicle), so that clause is not open to her — it makes no difference, because POL-NS-06 already gives the full refund. The driver's points that this is not a wrong-entrance or circling case and that no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises (registered_pickup_points is 1) are accepted. No referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was not false, and no other clause adds one. No escalation: the artifacts carrying the deciding dwell and fee facts — trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown — are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the trace has 25 fixes and no gaps, the rider track is present, the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 2, and the fare reconciles, so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d); the profiles show 0 disputes between these parties and 0 rider no-show disputes in 30 days, and the driver's anti-farming counters (1 termination against 110 completed trips) do not trip POL-NS-07 or POL-NS-09(d). Confidence 0.95, within the 1.0 cap set by those weight-1.0 artifacts.

Both sides largely agree on the facts, and the record decides the money.

WHAT HAPPENED. You booked a RYDE_POOL trip from West Grove (STANDARD pickup zone) at 13:12:40. The driver's device shows him stationary at the pickup pin from 13:12:50 to 13:16:50. At 13:13:20 he messaged: 'Wait for a match; the base fare is too low.' At 13:14:00 you replied: 'I stopped matching. Please unlock and go.' You cancelled at 13:16:50. The ledger charged you a SGD 4.00 cancellation fee.

THE DECIDING POINT — WAITING TIME. Under POL-NS-01 limb (c), the fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD zone, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The driver's own trace records one qualifying in-geofence run, first fix 13:12:50, last fix 13:16:50 — 240 seconds. That is 60 seconds short of the 300-second minimum. Limb (c) fails on the driver's own telemetry, and both advocates accept the arithmetic.

LIMB (d) ALSO FAILS. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated by the driver. This trip record shows cancelled_by 'RIDER' with status 'CANCELLED_BY_RIDER'. The termination element is not made out.

Because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied, the fee is not chargeable. POL-NS-06 then directs the refund route: an effective in-geofence dwell below the minimum means the cancellation fee is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The only way the 60-second gap could be closed is POL-NS-06(i), which sums separate in-geofence intervals only where a present, populated traffic advisory of an admissible type covers the pickup road. The only advisory for this trip, EV-ADVIS-00706-01, is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0. It carries no fact; it is citable only as an absence, and the shortfall stands.

AMOUNT. The fare breakdown itemises a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00, with base_fare, waiting_time_fee, platform_fee and refund_issued_sgd all 0.00, payment_status CHARGED. SGD 4.00 is also exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces here: the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee (4.00) are equal, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. The full refund is SGD 4.00 and is confined to the cancellation-fee line.

CLAIMS ANSWERED. (1) The driver's proximity claim is accepted but does not save the fee: his 25 fixes qualify, he sat 2.32 m mean / 3.71 m max from the pin at a constant 0.0 km/h, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and limb (b) is met — but limb (c) still fails on dwell and limb (d) on who terminated the trip. (2) No false arrival: the 'arrived' event at 13:12:40 sits 10 seconds from the nearest fix, far inside POL-NS-05's 90-second clock-skew tolerance and nowhere near its 300 m or 15 km/h triggers, so POL-NS-05(ii) produces no false-arrival referral. (3) POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver held a single continuous in-geofence interval (run_count 1, no excursion), he was inside the 50 m arrival radius, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill branch could not apply in any event. (4) POL-NS-04 is at best arguable on limb (a): 'I stopped matching. Please unlock and go.' is a demand to proceed rather than the position, entrance, block, tower, bay, position-request or cannot-see-vehicle content limb (a) names, though limbs (b) and (c) are otherwise met (no driver reply within 120 seconds, no in-app calls, rider within 13.67 m of the pin). Nothing turns on it — POL-NS-06 delivers the same full refund with no driver compensation — so I decide the refund on POL-NS-06 and leave the POL-NS-04 question where the money does not depend on it. (5) The driver's chat message and his admission that he asked you to wait for another match do not create an additional ground of decision under this category; no loaded clause converts that conduct into more than the refund the shortfall already gives, and no loaded clause produces a driver-conduct referral. (6) No driver compensation: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. Even if it were, the anti-farming check does not trip — 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 110 completed trips, a rate of about 0.009, well under the 4-count and 0.08 triggers — and POL-NS-06 expressly provides no compensation on a shortfall.

NO ESCALATION. POL-NS-09 is not engaged: no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (the trace and the trip record agree, and the rider's track corroborates her presence at the pin); no POL-NS-07 anti-farming trigger; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the two counterparty-dispute counters are both 0. The deciding facts — the 240-second dwell and the driver's position — are carried by EV-GPS-00706 and EV-TRIP-00706, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with no POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment (no gap, 25 fixes, rider track present, 2 chat messages matching chat_message_count 2, fare lines reconciling). The confidence cap is therefore 1.0, and no referral is produced by any clause.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on this trip is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable.

What decides it — the waiting period was too short. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four limbs hold, and limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup (trip record, pickup_zone_class STANDARD). Measured as the clause directs — from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 13:12:50, not from the 13:12:40 'arrived' tap, to the cancellation at 13:16:50 — the driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00706, weight 1.0, 25 fixes, no gaps) records a single continuous run of 240 seconds. That is 60 seconds short of the 300-second minimum. Both advocates accept this arithmetic.

POL-NS-06 then applies directly: where the effective dwell is shorter than the minimum, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded. The 60-second shortfall cannot be closed under POL-NS-06(i), because that limb requires a present, populated traffic advisory and the only advisory for this road (EV-ADVIS-00706-01) is MISSING at weight 0.0, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is citable only as an absence, which the rider's claim correctly disclosed.

The charge is exactly SGD 4.00 (EV-FARE-00706: cancellation_fee 4.00, base_fare 0.00, platform_fee 0.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That figure is also what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces — the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee (4.00) are equal, so the greater-of rule changes nothing — and there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The whole cancellation-fee line is refunded; there is no booking or platform fee to return.

The trip record independently fails POL-NS-01 limb (d): it shows cancelled_by RIDER and status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER at 13:16:50, not a termination by the driver. Limb (c) alone already settles the fee.

No driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it and states expressly that no compensation is payable on a shortfall. The anti-farming check is not met in any event (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 110 — below the 4-termination count and far below the 0.08 rate).

On the rider's account of the doors being kept locked pending a second match: the rider's description, the driver's own chat message 'Wait for a match; the base fare is too low.' at 13:13:20 (EV-CHAT-00706) and the driver's counterparty admission that he asked her to wait for another match are consistent, and I accept them as to what happened. But no clause in the NO_SHOW_CHARGE policy converts driver pool-matching conduct into a refund, a payment or a referral; the money is decided by the dwell shortfall above. POL-NS-05(ii)'s false-arrival record does not fire — the arrival marker was true (nearest fix 0.85 m from the pin, 0.0 km/h, a 10-second event-to-fix offset, well inside the 90-second skew tolerance) and the driver genuinely held the pin (all 25 fixes within 3.71 m).

The rider's POL-NS-04 route would also yield a full refund with no compensation, but it need not be reached; and the driver's contrary reading of limb (a) of that clause is not outcome-changing. POL-NS-02 (all qualifying in-radius fixes present) and POL-NS-05 (no false marker) are satisfied and likewise leave the result unchanged.

Escalation is not engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the counterparty-dispute counters are both 0; the anti-farming check is not met; and every artifact carrying the deciding fact (the trip record and the GPS trace, both weight 1.0) is unimpaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d).

No referral. No clause in this category produces one on these facts. The one open question for the platform — whether a POOL driver may hold a confirmed rider while soliciting a second match — is a product-policy matter worth the reviewer's attention, but it is not a clause-mandated referral and it carries no money.

Confidence 0.94: the deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, so no discount applies under POL-GEN-02(2). The disputed SGD 4.00 is returned to the rider; driver compensation SGD 0.00.
